versions.changelog:
- No changes detected; this version is identical to the previous release.
- Users can expect consistent documentation and behavior.

Initial release of shell-shortcuts.

- Adds easy-to-configure cross-platform terminal shortcuts: `proxy_on`, `proxy_off`, `goto`, and `gpu`.
- Supports persistent path jump shortcuts with `goto`, including add/list/remove features.
- `proxy_on`/`proxy_off` control environment variables and global Git proxy settings.
- Optional Conda environment auto-activation included.
- Windows PowerShell profile support with recommended usage; CMD and macOS/Linux setups documented.
- All commands are designed to be idempotent and easy to install on a new machine.
